scientific_integrity: Full exact proof with stated field quantifiers, embedded standalone checker, and explicit credit to prior techniques and covered special cases. Independently validated results are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite path algebras of quivers without oriented paths of length two; arrow coordinates and their labels are specified, not arbitrary changes of radical basis. The elementary FK polynomial, individual edge marginals, and two-vertex Kronecker commutator fibers have prior coverage. Finite checks alone do not establish general correctness. Undiscovered equivalent probabilistic-graph formulations are a residual originality risk.
title: Commutator-coordinate independence detects the graphic matroid of a radical-square-zero path algebra
